def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import defaultdict
    p=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] not in (0,):
                p[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    for color,pts in p.items():
        if len(pts)<2: continue
        # find a diagonal pair that establishes a ray direction
        found=None
        for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
            for rr,cc in pts[i+1:]:
                dr,dc=rr-r,cc-c
                if dr and abs(dr)==abs(dc):
                    step=(1 if dr>0 else -1, 1 if dc>0 else -1)
                    found=(r,c,rr,cc,step); break
            if found: break
        if not found: continue
        r,c,rr,cc,(sr,sc)=found
        # extend line at both ends, only over background
        for ar,ac,vr,vc in ((r-sr,c-sc,-sr,-sc),(rr+sr,cc+sc,sr,sc)):
            while 0<=ar<h and 0<=ac<w:
                if g[ar][ac] in (6,7,9): g[ar][ac]=color
                ar+=vr; ac+=vc
    return g
PY
